note: In the pines on the Norbeck Byway a mile north of Custer, close to Crazy Horse, Sylvan Lake, the Needles and Jewel Cave. Water-and-electric and full-hookup back-ins and full-hookup pull-throughs (cable on the full-hookup sites), plus electric and basic tent sites, tipis and cabins; private bathroom-and-shower rooms in two buildings, dog parks and an old-west play fort. --Claude
